text: BAM share fell 0.31 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.46 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 32.2% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 21.4% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 64 top-node leadership changes in the 2026-06-20 to 2026-08-10 window fit whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated.
